facts.fact: A decree signed by President Doumbouya on 21 May 2026 created the Digital Sovereignty Fund (FSN), to be financed primarily by revenue from the new 3% Digital Compliance Fee (RCN) on foreign digital services, to fund technology infrastructure, cybersecurity, training and innovation; the story reports creation, not yet any money collected or paid, and enforcement follows a six-month transition.

systems.owner: State of Guinea (created by presidential decree)

systems.country_label: Plateforme d'Analyse et de Régulation Numérique

note: The fee's yield is assigned primarily to the FSN, so the fund counts as a levy-fed fund; no amount, budget line or collection is stated.
